name: anthropic
description: Anthropic Claude API: messages (non-streaming), token counting, models, files and message batches

nodes.title: Create message
nodes.description: Ask Claude (not streamed); the reply text is in content[] blocks of type text. Check stop_reason (end_turn, max_tokens, refusal, tool_use)

model.description: Model id, e.g. claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-haiku-5-5

max_tokens.description: Cap on output tokens (non-streaming: keep it at most about 16000)

tool_choice.description: {"type":"auto"} (forced tool choice is refused by the newest models)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get message batch results
nodes.description: Results of an ended message batch as a list of {custom_id, result: {type: succeeded|errored|canceled|expired, message|error}} in any order; filter with custom_ids or result_type and page with offset (agents see 100 at a time)

batch_id.description: Message batch id (msgbatch_...); processing_status must be ended

offset.description: Skip this many matching results (file order), e.g. 100 for the second page
